


```{r echo=FALSE}
TR_TARGET <- c(100,475,1000,2475,5000,10000)
Vs30_TARGET <- 250
CAP <- "Fundamental periods and shear modulus for slopes. Heights Hs in [m], crest width b in [m], Shear moduli Go in [MPa], Shear wave velocity at the base VSo in [m/s] and Fundamental Period Ts in [s] (Quantile p=%s). The material properties are expressed in terms of the Universal Soil Classification System (USCS) "
```

## Fundamental Periods and Shear Modulus

::: {.panel-tabset  }
### p=mean

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- "mean"
Caption <- CAP |> sprintf(p_TARGET)
TBL <- SHT[level==p_TARGET,.(ID,Name,USCS,level,b,s,Hs,Go,VSo,mo,lo,an,Ts)]
TBL |> buildTable(library="gt",font.size.body = 12,font.size.header = 14,font.bold.header=TRUE,caption=Caption)

```


### p=5%

